ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as INGs software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? Your day to day: You will design, develop and maintain customized IT solutions in a heterogeneous environment with a mix of classic JEE distributed middleware applications and a microservice oriented target platform.You will reengineer and support the continuous migration of our classic components towards a modern microservice oriented platform.You will work with technologies such as classic J2EE, Spring/Spring Boot, Oracle, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, REST, Maven and Git within the Java Enterprise Landscape. You take responsibility for the entire software development process: from analysis and technical conception to the design of distributed and modern IT architectures in the Java environment to implementation, testing, documentation and the implementation of governance and regulatory requirements You will support us in our plan to completely renew our IT landscape and operate it in a hybrid cloud infrastructureTo this end, you will analyze our complex existing system landscape, develop migration scenarios, and ensure smooth parallel operation on the way to the target architecture.Together with the team, you will be responsible for the central database-structures and develop them further using Oracle SQL and PL/SQL technologies.You will support us in ensuring and documenting the IT compliance of the applications for which you are responsible.You will ensure that software quality is maintained and improved by carrying out code reviews and sharing knowledge with your colleagues.Creating automated tests with JUnit and monitoring the results in Teamscale and FortifyTogether with the team, you constantly analyze potential for increasing customer satisfaction and improving interdisciplinary collaboration with Product Owners, Customer Journey Experts and Feature Engineers. What youll bring to the team: Customer focus in the banking environment and want to reach many customers with your softwareUniversity degree with a focus on software development, e.g. in (business) computer science or a comparable qualification, 5 years of practical experience in software development with JavaIdeally know the requirements of a regulated environment,Strong conceptual understanding of IT architecture and secure operationExperience in working with Java, JEE, Spring/Spring Boot, Oracle, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, Maven and Git as well as IntelliJ, Know-how or experience in complex Java middleware distributed architecturesDevOps is not an unfamiliar concept to you and you enjoy working hand in hand with DevOps colleaguesalready have knowledge of the hybrid cloud/private cloud, that would be an advantage (Docker/Kubernetes, OpenShift, Elastic Search, Ansible, Microsoft Azure)Enjoy working closely in a team and agile software developmentLike to take responsibility for driving topics forward and want to actively help shape our technical roadmap Strong communication skills and enjoy sharing your knowledge (e.g. in the form of workshops, peer programming or mentoring)If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).
